Pattern of thought

As soon as I read the prompt for day 10 (“pattern”) I instantly got a bunch of different ideas. I tried a few, but none of them felt right. Then I came across the 3rd image in this series (white 3D close-up-fabric-looking pattern) and instantly knew how I could combine it with the brick wall. The result is this multilayered story I wish were written on a wall near me.

About this piece

As soon as I read the prompt for day 10 (“pattern”) I instantly got a bunch of different ideas. I tried a few, but none of them felt right. Then I came across the 3rd image in this series (white 3D close-up-fabric-looking pattern) and instantly knew how I could combine it with the brick wall. The result is this multilayered story I wish were written on a wall near me.
